title: SpeakSoftly: Scaffolding Nonviolent Communication in Intimate Relationships through LLM-Powered Just-In-Time Interventions
reasoning: The paper focuses on a communication support system (SpeakSoftly) using Nonviolent Communication (NVC) principles to help couples manage conflicts. While it involves psychological scaffolding and communication techniques, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, faith-based, or formal ethical/moral frameworks.
